tasks.task: Audit a product's interface for inconsistency

items.when: When screens were built by many hands and you must count the distinct colours, sizes and parts in use
When the product is a live site, to pull its real colours, fonts and spacing as a starting list
When you have the component code, to find naming problems and hardcoded values
When one page stands for the rest, to check contrast, spacing, hierarchy and mobile
When the audit lists forty variants and you must decide which few serve a purpose

tasks.task: Build a design token set from a brand or brief

items.when: When you need primitives, semantic tokens and light and dark values as JSON, CSS and Tailwind
Before naming tokens, to fix the firm rules for colour, type and grid they must carry
When the tokens also need component notes, responsive sizes and a developer handoff
When you want one run from brief to rules, checked colours and a developer spec
Before the set is published, to check every text and background pair in light and dark
When the set keeps growing and needs fewer choices with clearer rules

tasks.task: Turn scattered CSS into one named token set

items.when: When colours, sizes and spacings live in CSS or SCSS files and need one shared set of names
When the merged values must become a full set with semantic names and both themes
When you cannot get the source files, to read the values from the live site
After the swap, to find hardcoded values the new tokens should have replaced

tasks.task: Add dark mode values from a light palette

items.when: When a light theme works and the team wants dark mode without a redesign
When the dark values must be written into the token files beside the light ones
When dark values are drafted, to check each pair and get the nearest passing colour
When charts and data colours must also work in dark mode

tasks.task: Deliver tokens as CSS variables, a Tailwind theme or a design file

items.when: When developers need the tokens in the exact format their build uses
When AI coding tools will build screens and need the rules in one design file they can read
When the tokens must be wired into the project's code and the build re-run
When the design team works in Figma and you must check how it takes the values

tasks.task: Write a component spec and documentation page

items.when: When one component needs purpose, anatomy, variants, every state, tokens and keyboard rules written
Before the spec, to list the states people hit first: empty, loading, error and success
When you have the source files and want a guided run to a brief with variants and states
When the design is finished and the spec must cover props, breakpoints and edge cases
When a component changed, to find the states and variants still missing
When the spec is drafted, to test its keyboard, focus and screen reader behaviour

tasks.task: Write a design brief for one screen or flow

items.when: Before anyone designs a new screen, so it uses existing components and covers every state
When the screen is part of a flow, to set the steps and navigation first
When the layout is open, to get text wireframes at three levels of detail to compare
When the screen should be built from the product's own components and tokens
When the screen comes back, to review it against the system before build

tasks.task: Check a design handoff before developers start

items.when: Before developers start on a designed screen or component, to catch what is missing
When a changed component needs its missing states listed and a review request written
When the check finds missing states, to design them
When the handoff has no spec at all, to write layout, tokens, props and edge cases

tasks.task: Set up a starter design system

items.when: When a product has drift and no system, or is about to add dark mode or a second brand
Before you choose what goes in the system, to see what the product really uses
When the team has no guide, to get a plain first one with tokens and part rules to react to
When the starter set needs real responsive, accessible components in code
When the starter system needs a small icon set that reads as one family
When the system is a pile of parts with no stated purpose or shared rule

tasks.task: Version and release a library or token update

items.when: When a change must ship with the right version number, notes and deprecations
When you are about to publish a library or token update and need the notes written
When the changes live in commits, to draft notes and the version bump from them
Before the release, to get a go or no-go, a rollback plan and a live check

tasks.task: Plan a move to a new design system

items.when: When screens must move to new components without breaking what is live
When you have the source files and need a change inventory, swap rules and stages
When you want a second plan for retiring the old parts and moving teams over
Before each stage, to list what to test so a swapped component does not break a screen

tasks.task: Run the monthly design system health check

items.when: Monthly on a fixed day, and after any major release
When the code can be read each month, to find drift and get a spec to approve
When new components were added, to check names and hardcoded values
When colours changed this month, to re-check the pairs

tasks.task: Review a new screen against the system

items.when: When a new screen arrives, to check it uses the system's parts and rules
When you have a mockup or Figma link, for hierarchy and consistency feedback with fixes
Before release, to list visual gaps that must close first
When the review is done, to turn it into an issue list and a revised brief

tasks.task: Check components for contrast, keyboard and focus

items.when: When the fixes must be written into each component's keyboard and focus rules
When you need the gaps by level and the fixes ranked
When a component needs a test plan for keyboard and screen reader use
When you have the code, to fix the problems found and check again

tasks.task: Define empty, loading and error states with their words

items.when: When a screen or component has only its happy state designed
When states need button labels, errors and toasts, to get wording to choose from
When the states must be added in code so nobody stares at a blank box
When the product already has messages, to review the current text and rewrite the weak ones

tasks.task: Set the type scale, spacing and grid

items.when: When the scale must be written as tokens with names that will last
When the fonts are open, to compare pairs with sizes and line spacing for screens
When a page type needs a grid, a short type list and a white-space plan
When a screen built on the scale still looks flat, to fix spacing, type and depth
When spacing is set by eye on each screen and needs one grid

tasks.task: Set motion rules for components

items.when: When a change adds motion, to get a table of fixes and an approve or block call
When the team cannot picture the motion, to see a static design animated

tasks.task: Set chart and data colours that fit the system

items.when: When charts need palettes and colour maps that match the product and work in dark mode
When chart styles are drafted, to check colours and axes do not mislead
When data colours sit on both light and dark backgrounds

tasks.task: Extend the system to iOS and Android

items.when: When the same tokens must be delivered in the formats native apps use
When components must fit each platform, with thumb-friendly layout and offline states
When an iOS screen is drafted, to check it against Apple's design rules

tasks.task: Turn a brand into product design rules

items.when: When the brand is a set of screenshots or links, to turn them into a profile you can reuse
When the feeling is agreed, to write firm rules for colour, type and grid
When there is no org context at all, to get a first one to react to
When the rules are agreed and must become tokens

tasks.task: Build or add components that follow the system

items.when: Before the build, to plan the component list, accessibility and tests
When a screen must be coded with accessible, responsive components that follow the system
When the project needs ready-made components added with the right setup
When components are built in React, to add tests for the parts that lack them
When you want a quick live preview of a component idea before speccing it

always.when: Before any token or component work on a product with a live site: its colours, fonts and voice
Before any spec or screen leaves, to check contrast, spacing, hierarchy and mobile

helpers.when: When whole screens or flows must be designed, not only briefed and reviewed
When tokens and components must be built, tested and shipped in the codebase
When the product needs a full accessibility audit or a formal statement
When there is no agreed palette, type or logo to build the tokens from
When the flow itself is wrong and consistent parts will not fix it
When the system needs a full documentation site written and kept up

gaps: No library item writes tokens in the W3C design tokens format or sets up Style Dictionary or Figma variables
No library item derives dark mode values from a light palette; the library only checks the contrast afterwards
No library item counts distinct values from screenshots or a Figma file and proposes which to merge
No library item sets token naming rules or reviews names for how long they will last
No library item picks a version number or writes deprecations for a design library; release items are for code
No library item covers Figma library structure: variables, modes, publishing and usage analytics
No library item covers system governance: who may add a component, how requests are handled and how adoption is tracked
No library item sets up visual regression tests or a component documentation site
No library item plans multi-brand or white-label theming from one token set
No library item writes motion tokens: durations, easing and reduced-motion rules
